## Standing operator rules
Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.

Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.

Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

Integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64; the ci-runner-small pool is retired and hangs.

## Current objective
Fix the webhook signature verification failure in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py` causing customer 400s. Pagination work was superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
Adding an invoices `(customer_id, created_at)` covering index was ruled out because it doubled ingest write latency.

## Plan and progress
PDF rendering fixes, tests, lint, pagination, and billing tests: done. SQLAlchemy 2.0 `DeclarativeBase` migration edit: done; validation pending. Webhook investigation: pending; exact next command was not provided. Staging smoke test and commit: pending.

## Recent work
PDF tests: `14 passed, 1 skipped in 2.07s`; billing: `83 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed in 6.41s`; full baseline: `148 passed, 2 skipped`. Updated `ledgerly/models.py` from `declarative_base()` to `class Base(DeclarativeBase)`. No post-edit test result yet.
